controls/make_controls.py:
"""Generate control submissions for grader validation.

Run with /usr/local/bin/python3. Writes controls/artifacts/*.h5ad.

Controls:
  correct                      full pinned pipeline (seed order)
  permuted                     correct with rows and columns reordered (must pass)
  partial-no-log1p             normalization omits log1p
  wrong-thresholds             pct_counts_mt < 10, min_cells=10 (wrong membership)
  same-shape-wrong-membership  2638x13714 but 50 barcodes relabeled to
                               QC-dropped cells (must fail exact-membership G1)
  dependency-violation         one raw count perturbed; QC/normalization
                               recomputed on the perturbed counts
  missing-counts-layer         h5ad without the counts layer
  nonfinite-counts             NaN in the counts layer
  malformed                    not an h5ad at all (truncated bytes)
  empty                        absence of a file (handled by the runner)
"""

from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import scanpy as sc

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
OUT = HERE / "artifacts"
OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
DATA = HERE.parent / "data" / "filtered_gene_bc_matrices" / "hg19"


def load_filtered(pct_mt_max=5, min_cells=3):
    adata = sc.read_10x_mtx(DATA, var_names="gene_symbols", cache=False)
    adata.var_names_make_unique()
    # seed order: cell filter first, then gene filter
    sc.pp.filter_cells(adata, min_genes=200)
    sc.pp.filter_genes(adata, min_cells=min_cells)
    adata.var["mt"] = adata.var_names.str.startswith("MT-")
    sc.pp.calculate_qc_metrics(
        adata, qc_vars=["mt"], percent_top=None, log1p=False, inplace=True
    )
    kept = adata[
        (adata.obs.n_genes_by_counts < 2500)
        & (adata.obs.n_genes_by_counts > 200)
        & (adata.obs.pct_counts_mt < pct_mt_max),
        :,
    ].copy()
    kept.layers["counts"] = kept.X.copy()
    return kept


def recompute_qc(adata):
    sc.pp.calculate_qc_metrics(
        adata, qc_vars=["mt"], percent_top=None, log1p=False, inplace=True
    )


# correct: full pinned pipeline
adata = load_filtered()
sc.pp.normalize_total(adata, target_sum=1e4)
sc.pp.log1p(adata)
adata.write_h5ad(OUT / "correct.h5ad", compression="gzip")

# permuted: same content, rows and columns reordered
rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
perm = adata[np.random.permutation(adata.n_obs), np.random.permutation(adata.n_vars)].copy()
perm.write_h5ad(OUT / "permuted.h5ad", compression="gzip")

# partial: normalization without log1p
adata = load_filtered()
sc.pp.normalize_total(adata, target_sum=1e4)
adata.write_h5ad(OUT / "partial-no-log1p.h5ad", compression="gzip")

# scientifically wrong: wrong QC thresholds
adata = load_filtered(pct_mt_max=10, min_cells=10)
sc.pp.normalize_total(adata, target_sum=1e4)
sc.pp.log1p(adata)
adata.write_h5ad(OUT / "wrong-thresholds.h5ad", compression="gzip")

# same shape, wrong membership: relabel 50 retained barcodes to cells that the
# pinned QC filter drops (same dimensions, must fail exact-membership G1)
adata = load_filtered()
full = sc.read_10x_mtx(DATA, var_names="gene_symbols", cache=False)
full.var_names_make_unique()
sc.pp.filter_cells(full, min_genes=200)
sc.pp.filter_genes(full, min_cells=3)
full.var["mt"] = full.var_names.str.startswith("MT-")
sc.pp.calculate_qc_metrics(
    full, qc_vars=["mt"], percent_top=None, log1p=False, inplace=True
)
dropped = set(full.obs_names) - set(adata.obs_names)
fake = list(dropped)[:50]
new_names = adata.obs_names.to_numpy(copy=True)
new_names[:50] = fake
adata.obs_names = new_names
sc.pp.normalize_total(adata, target_sum=1e4)
sc.pp.log1p(adata)
adata.write_h5ad(OUT / "same-shape-wrong-membership.h5ad", compression="gzip")

# dependency violation: perturbed counts layer with internally consistent
# QC and normalization, so only lineage (G3) passes its own check and
# G2/G4 must be withheld by dependency
adata = load_filtered()
counts = adata.layers["counts"].tocsr()
counts[0, 5] = counts[0, 5] + 7  # altered raw count
adata.layers["counts"] = counts
adata.X = counts.copy().astype(np.float32)
recompute_qc(adata)
sc.pp.normalize_total(adata, target_sum=1e4)
sc.pp.log1p(adata)
adata.write_h5ad(OUT / "dependency-violation.h5ad", compression="gzip")

# missing counts layer: normalized X only
adata = load_filtered()
sc.pp.normalize_total(adata, target_sum=1e4)
sc.pp.log1p(adata)
del adata.layers["counts"]
adata.write_h5ad(OUT / "missing-counts-layer.h5ad", compression="gzip")

# nonfinite counts: NaN injected into the counts layer
adata = load_filtered()
counts = adata.layers["counts"].tocsr().astype(np.float32)
counts[0, 0] = np.nan
adata.layers["counts"] = counts
sc.pp.normalize_total(adata, target_sum=1e4)
sc.pp.log1p(adata)
adata.write_h5ad(OUT / "nonfinite-counts.h5ad", compression="gzip")

# malformed: not an h5ad
(OUT / "malformed.h5ad").write_bytes(b"not an hdf5 file at all" * 100)

print("controls written:", sorted(p.name for p in OUT.iterdir()))

task/instruction.md:
# PBMC3k single-cell RNA-seq: quality control, filtering, and normalization

## Attribution

The input data are 3k peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) from a healthy
donor, collected by 10x Genomics (Cell Ranger 1.1.0, hg19, published
2016-05-26), distributed by 10x Genomics under CC BY 4.0. Same donor as the
public pbmc6k dataset. This attribution must be preserved in any redistribution
of the data or derived artifacts.

## Objective

Starting from the raw 10x Genomics count matrix staged at
`/inputs/filtered_gene_bc_matrices/hg19/` (`matrix.mtx`, `genes.tsv`,
`barcodes.tsv`; genes on rows, cells on columns, 2700 cells x 32738 genes),
perform quality control, cell/gene filtering, and library-size normalization
with log transformation, and write the result as an AnnData `.h5ad` file at
exactly `/output/pbmc3k_qc.h5ad`.

Internet access is disabled. Inspect the environment for available software;
required dependencies are installed.

## Methodology (consequential parameters)

Follow this order; the steps, thresholds, and boundary conditions are part of
the contract:

1. **Load** the 10x matrix. Feature names are gene symbols (column 2 of
   `genes.tsv`); if symbols collide, make them unique in any way that keeps
   one row per input gene (e.g. appending a numeric suffix), and never collapse
   duplicate symbols. Independently of the symbols, carry the **stable input
   gene identifiers** (column 1 of `genes.tsv`, one per gene row) through every
   filtering step in a `.var` metadata column named exactly `gene_ids`
   (see the output contract).
2. **Cell filter (counts)**: remove cells with fewer than 200 detected genes
   (count > 0); cells with exactly 200 detected genes are kept at this step.
   (On this dataset this removes no cells, but the step is part of the
   contract.)
3. **Gene filter**: remove genes detected (count > 0) in fewer than 3 cells.
4. **QC metrics**: annotate mitochondrial genes as those whose input gene
   symbol starts with `MT-` (13 genes survive step 3 in this dataset), stored as
   a boolean `.var` column named exactly `mt`. For every remaining cell
   compute, from the filtered count matrix:
   - `n_genes_by_counts`: number of genes with count > 0,
   - `total_counts`: total UMI count,
   - `pct_counts_mt`: percentage of counts in mitochondrial genes.
5. **Cell filter (QC)**: keep cells with `200 < n_genes_by_counts < 2500`
   (both bounds exclusive) and `pct_counts_mt < 5`. Expected scale: 2638 cells
   and 13714 genes remain from 2700 x 32738.
6. **Normalize**: for each retained cell, scale its counts so the cell's total
   is exactly 10,000 counts (counts divided by the cell's `total_counts`,
   multiplied by 10000), then apply `log1p`. Store the result in `X`.
7. Keep the filtered raw integer counts in a layer named `counts`. Use sparse
   representations throughout; do not densify the full matrix.

## Output contract

Write `/output/pbmc3k_qc.h5ad` such that:

- `X` is the log1p library-size-normalized (counts-per-10k) matrix, cells on
  rows, genes on columns, with no NaN or infinite values.
- `.obs_names` are the retained barcodes from `barcodes.tsv` (any order).
- `.var` contains, aligned with its rows:
  - a column named exactly `gene_ids` holding the **input gene identifiers**
    (column 1 of `genes.tsv`) of the genes retained by step 3, one per row,
    each appearing exactly once; this column is the lineage key used for
    grading and must not be altered;
  - a boolean column named exactly `mt` marking the mitochondrial genes.
- `.var_names` are unique gene symbols (any consistent disambiguation of
  duplicate input symbols is accepted; symbols are not used as a grading key).
- A layer named `counts` holds the filtered raw integer counts for exactly the
  same cells and genes, matching the input matrix at those indices.
- `.obs` contains the columns `n_genes_by_counts`, `total_counts`, and
  `pct_counts_mt` computed on the final filtered cell set.

The file must be readable with the staged HDF5 tooling. Numeric checks compare
against recomputation from your own `counts` layer, the `gene_ids` lineage
column, and the raw staged input, so any correct implementation passes; only
the values above are graded, not the software used.

A missing, unreadable, or malformed artifact (including a missing `counts`
layer, `gene_ids`, or `mt` column, or nonfinite values) scores zero; it does
not crash the grader.
reference/run_reference.py:
"""Author reference: seed methodology, QC/filter/normalize scope only.

Writes reference/pbmc3k_qc.h5ad and reference/reference_stats.json.
Run with /usr/local/bin/python3.
"""

import json
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import scanpy as sc

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
DATA = HERE.parent / "data" / "filtered_gene_bc_matrices" / "hg19"

adata = sc.read_10x_mtx(DATA, var_names="gene_symbols", cache=False)
adata.var_names_make_unique()

n_cells_raw, n_genes_raw = adata.n_obs, adata.n_vars

sc.pp.filter_cells(adata, min_genes=200)
sc.pp.filter_genes(adata, min_cells=3)
after_gene_filter = (adata.n_obs, adata.n_vars)

adata.var["mt"] = adata.var_names.str.startswith("MT-")
sc.pp.calculate_qc_metrics(adata, qc_vars=["mt"], percent_top=None, log1p=False, inplace=True)

adata = adata[
    (adata.obs.n_genes_by_counts < 2500)
    & (adata.obs.n_genes_by_counts > 200)
    & (adata.obs.pct_counts_mt < 5),
    :,
].copy()
adata.layers["counts"] = adata.X.copy()

sc.pp.normalize_total(adata, target_sum=1e4)
sc.pp.log1p(adata)

# internal consistency: X == log1p(counts / rowsum * 1e4) on nonzero entries
counts = adata.layers["counts"].tocsr()
X = adata.X.tocsr()
rowsum = np.asarray(counts.sum(axis=1)).ravel()
recomputed = counts.multiply((1e4 / rowsum)[:, None])
recomputed.data = np.log1p(recomputed.data)
diff = abs(X.data - recomputed.data).max()

stats = {
    "scanpy_version": sc.__version__,
    "raw_shape": [n_cells_raw, n_genes_raw],
    "after_min_cells3_min_genes200": list(after_gene_filter),
    "filtered_shape": [adata.n_obs, adata.n_vars],
    "n_mt_genes": int(adata.var["mt"].sum()),
    "median_total_counts": float(np.median(adata.obs["total_counts"])),
    "median_pct_counts_mt": float(np.median(adata.obs["pct_counts_mt"])),
    "max_normalization_recompute_diff": float(diff),
    "first5_barcodes": list(adata.obs_names[:5]),
    "n_cells_after_gene_filter_pass": int(after_gene_filter[0]),
}
adata.write_h5ad(HERE / "pbmc3k_qc.h5ad", compression="gzip")
(HERE / "reference_stats.json").write_text(json.dumps(stats, indent=2))
print(json.dumps(stats, indent=2))

task/tests/grade.py:
"""Deterministic grader for the PBMC3k QC/normalization task.

Subgoals (weights in grading-contract.json):
  G1 filtered_membership - retained cell and gene identities match the pinned
                           methodology exactly (recomputed independently of
                           Scanpy from the raw input; reordering is allowed).
  G2 qc_metrics          - the boolean `mt` var column matches the input
                           symbols, and obs QC columns are consistent with the
                           submission's own (lineage-validated) counts layer.
  G3 counts_lineage      - the counts layer equals the raw input matrix exactly
                           at the submitted barcodes and gene_ids.
  G4 normalization       - X equals log1p(CP10k) recomputed from the counts
                           layer.

Dependencies: G2 requires G1 and G3; G3 requires G1; G4 requires G1 and G3.

Exit codes:
  0 - grading completed; stdout is JSON with "subgoals" and "reward".
      Invalid submissions (missing/unreadable/malformed artifact, missing
      counts layer, gene_ids or mt column, nonfinite or non-integer counts)
      also exit 0 with reward 0.0 - they are graded, not errors.
  3 - verifier/infrastructure failure (missing raw input, missing dependency,
      unexpected internal error). Such runs must stay ungraded, not zero.

Lineage uses the stable input gene identifiers (column 1 of genes.tsv) carried
in the var column `gene_ids`; gene symbols are never parsed for lineage.
"""

import json
import sys

ARTIFACT = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "/output/pbmc3k_qc.h5ad"
RAW_DIR = sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else "/inputs/filtered_gene_bc_matrices/hg19"

WEIGHTS = {"G1": 0.20, "G2": 0.25, "G3": 0.25, "G4": 0.30}
QC_TOL = 1e-3
PCT_TOL = 1e-2
NORM_TOL = 1e-4


def emit(subgoals, reward):
    print(json.dumps({"subgoals": subgoals, "reward": round(reward, 4)}, indent=2))
    sys.exit(0)


SUBGOAL_NAMES = {
    "G1": "filtered_membership",
    "G2": "qc_metrics",
    "G3": "counts_lineage",
    "G4": "normalization",
}


def invalid(reason):
    """A structurally invalid submission: graded zero, not a verifier error."""
    emit({g: {SUBGOAL_NAMES[g]: False, "detail": reason} for g in WEIGHTS}, 0.0)


def verifier_error(reason):
    print(f"VERIFIER FAILURE: {reason}", file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(3)


def as_csr(m):
    import numpy as np
    from scipy import sparse
    if isinstance(m, np.ndarray):
        return sparse.csr_matrix(m)
    return m.tocsr()


# --- verifier-side dependency and raw-input checks ------------------------
try:
    import anndata as ad  # noqa: F401
    import numpy as np
    import scipy.io
    from scipy import sparse
except Exception as e:
    verifier_error(f"grader dependency unavailable: {e}")

import os
for f in ("matrix.mtx", "genes.tsv", "barcodes.tsv"):
    if not os.path.isfile(f"{RAW_DIR}/{f}"):
        verifier_error(f"raw input missing: {RAW_DIR}/{f}")

try:
    # --- load submission (unreadable/missing -> invalid, not an error) ----
    try:
        adata = ad.read_h5ad(ARTIFACT)
    except Exception as e:
        invalid(f"artifact unreadable: {e}")

    if "counts" not in adata.layers:
        invalid("missing counts layer")
    for col in ("gene_ids", "mt"):
        if col not in adata.var.columns:
            invalid(f"missing var column: {col}")
    try:
        counts = as_csr(adata.layers["counts"])
    except Exception as e:
        invalid(f"counts layer unreadable: {e}")
    if counts.shape != (adata.n_obs, adata.n_vars):
        invalid("counts layer shape does not match obs/var")
    if not np.isfinite(counts.data).all():
        invalid("nonfinite value in counts layer")
    if not np.all(counts.data == np.round(counts.data)):
        invalid("counts layer is not integer-valued")
    if (counts.data < 0).any():
        invalid("negative value in counts layer")

    gene_ids = adata.var["gene_ids"].astype(str)
    if gene_ids.duplicated().any():
        invalid("duplicate gene_ids in var")
    if adata.obs_names.duplicated().any():
        invalid("duplicate barcodes in obs_names")

    try:
        Xc = as_csr(adata.X)
    except Exception as e:
        invalid(f"X unreadable: {e}")
    if not np.isfinite(Xc.data).all() and Xc.nnz:
        invalid("nonfinite value in X")

    # --- independently recompute the expected retained identities ---------
    # Pinned order: (1) remove cells with < 200 detected genes (>= 200 kept),
    # (2) remove genes detected in < 3 cells, (3) strict QC filter
    # 200 < n_genes_by_counts < 2500 and pct_counts_mt < 5.
    raw_gc = scipy.io.mmread(f"{RAW_DIR}/matrix.mtx").tocsr()  # genes x cells
    raw_gene_ids = [line.split("\t")[0].strip() for line in open(f"{RAW_DIR}/genes.tsv")]
    raw_symbols = [line.split("\t")[1].strip() for line in open(f"{RAW_DIR}/genes.tsv")]
    barcodes = [line.strip() for line in open(f"{RAW_DIR}/barcodes.tsv")]
    if len(set(raw_gene_ids)) != len(raw_gene_ids):
        verifier_error("raw gene ids are not unique; lineage key is ambiguous")
    if len(raw_gene_ids) != raw_gc.shape[0] or len(barcodes) != raw_gc.shape[1]:
        verifier_error("raw genes.tsv/barcodes.tsv disagree with matrix.mtx")

    raw = raw_gc.T  # cells x genes, csr
    genes_per_cell = np.asarray((raw > 0).sum(axis=1)).ravel()
    cell_keep = genes_per_cell >= 200
    raw = raw[cell_keep, :]
    cells_per_gene = np.asarray((raw > 0).sum(axis=0)).ravel()
    gene_keep = cells_per_gene >= 3
    raw = raw[:, gene_keep]

    kept_barcodes = [b for b, k in zip(barcodes, cell_keep) if k]
    kept_gene_ids = [g for g, k in zip(raw_gene_ids, gene_keep) if k]
    kept_symbols = [s for s, k in zip(raw_symbols, gene_keep) if k]

    # QC metrics on the doubly filtered matrix, strictly per the contract
    n_genes = np.asarray((raw > 0).sum(axis=1)).ravel()
    total = np.asarray(raw.sum(axis=1)).ravel()
    mt_mask_raw = np.array([s.startswith("MT-") for s in kept_symbols])
    mt_counts = np.asarray(raw[:, mt_mask_raw].sum(axis=1)).ravel()
    pct_mt = 100.0 * mt_counts / total
    qc_keep = (n_genes > 200) & (n_genes < 2500) & (pct_mt < 5)

    expected_barcodes = set(b for b, k in zip(kept_barcodes, qc_keep) if k)
    expected_gene_ids = set(kept_gene_ids)
    qc_barcodes = [b for b, k in zip(kept_barcodes, qc_keep) if k]

    # --- G1: exact membership (reordering allowed) ------------------------
    sub_cells = set(adata.obs_names)
    sub_genes = set(gene_ids)
    g1 = sub_cells == expected_barcodes and sub_genes == expected_gene_ids
    g1_detail = (f"cells {len(sub_cells)} vs {len(expected_barcodes)} expected, "
                 f"genes {len(sub_genes)} vs {len(expected_gene_ids)} expected")

    # --- G3: counts layer equals the raw input at submitted indices ------
    g3, g3_detail = False, "dependency G1 failed"
    if g1:
        try:
            bc_pos = {b: i for i, b in enumerate(barcodes)}
            gid_pos = {g: i for i, g in enumerate(raw_gene_ids)}
            rows = [bc_pos[b] for b in adata.obs_names]       # cells -> raw cols
            cols = [gid_pos[g] for g in gene_ids]             # genes -> raw rows
            # index the FULL raw matrix (genes x cells) by gene rows and cell
            # columns, then transpose to cells x genes
            sub = raw_gc[cols, :][:, rows].T.tocsr()
            diff = abs(counts - sub)
            worst = diff.max() if diff.nnz else 0.0
            g3 = worst == 0
            g3_detail = f"max counts deviation {worst:g} over {len(rows)}x{len(cols)}"
        except Exception as e:
            g3_detail = f"lineage check failed: {e}"

    # --- G2: mt annotation and QC metrics on lineage-validated counts ----
    g2, g2_detail = False, "dependency G1 or G3 failed"
    if g1 and g3:
        try:
            obs = adata.obs
            needed = {"n_genes_by_counts", "total_counts", "pct_counts_mt"}
            assert needed <= set(obs.columns), f"missing obs columns: {needed - set(obs.columns)}"

            mt_col = adata.var["mt"].astype(bool).to_numpy()
            gid_to_symbol = dict(zip(raw_gene_ids, raw_symbols))
            expected_mt = np.array([gid_to_symbol[g].startswith("MT-") for g in gene_ids])
            assert (mt_col == expected_mt).all(), "mt column disagrees with input symbols"

            assert mt_col.sum() == 13, f"expected 13 MT- genes, got {int(mt_col.sum())}"

            row_sums = np.asarray(counts.sum(axis=1)).ravel()
            n_genes_sub = np.asarray((counts > 0).sum(axis=1)).ravel()
            mt_counts_sub = np.asarray(counts[:, mt_col].sum(axis=1)).ravel()
            checks = [
                ("n_genes_by_counts",
                 np.abs(obs["n_genes_by_counts"].to_numpy(float) - n_genes_sub).max(), QC_TOL),
                ("total_counts",
                 np.abs(obs["total_counts"].to_numpy(float) - row_sums).max(), QC_TOL),
                ("pct_counts_mt",
                 np.abs(obs["pct_counts_mt"].to_numpy(float)
                        - 100.0 * mt_counts_sub / row_sums).max(), PCT_TOL),
            ]
            g2 = all(err <= tol for _, err, tol in checks)
            g2_detail = f"max metric deviation {max(c[1] for c in checks):.3g}"
        except Exception as e:
            g2_detail = f"QC check failed: {e}"

    # --- G4: X == log1p(CP10k) recomputed from the counts layer ----------
    g4, g4_detail = False, "dependency G1 or G3 failed"
    if g1 and g3:
        try:
            row_sums = np.asarray(counts.sum(axis=1)).ravel()
            assert np.all(row_sums > 0), "zero-count cell in counts layer"
            expected = counts.multiply((1e4 / row_sums)[:, None])
            expected.data = np.log1p(expected.data)
            # sparse subtraction compares the union of both supports, so
            # nonzero X entries outside the counts support are caught as well
            diff = abs(Xc - expected)
            max_diff = diff.max() if diff.nnz else 0.0
            g4 = max_diff <= NORM_TOL
            g4_detail = f"max X deviation {max_diff:.3g} (tolerance {NORM_TOL:g})"
        except Exception as e:
            g4_detail = f"normalization check failed: {e}"

    subgoals = {
        "G1": {"filtered_membership": bool(g1), "detail": g1_detail},
        "G2": {"qc_metrics": bool(g2), "detail": g2_detail},
        "G3": {"counts_lineage": bool(g3), "detail": g3_detail},
        "G4": {"normalization": bool(g4), "detail": g4_detail},
    }
    reward = sum(WEIGHTS[k] for k, v in subgoals.items() if v[list(v)[0]])
    emit(subgoals, reward)
except SystemExit:
    raise
except Exception as e:  # anything unexpected is a verifier failure, not zero
    verifier_error(f"unexpected grader error: {type(e).__name__}: {e}")

task/tests/test.sh:
#!/bin/bash
# Harbor verifier entry point. Distinguishes:
#  - graded runs (grade.py exit 0): reward extracted from grade.json, written
#    to /logs/verifier/reward.txt; invalid submissions are graded 0.0 here.
#  - verifier failures (grade.py exit 3: missing dependency, missing raw
#    input, unexpected internal error): the run stays UNGRADED; no reward
#    file is written and this script exits nonzero.
set -u

mkdir -p /logs/verifier

python3 /tests/grade.py /output/pbmc3k_qc.h5ad /inputs/filtered_gene_bc_matrices/hg19 \
  > /logs/verifier/grade.json 2> /logs/verifier/grade.err
rc=$?

if [ $rc -ne 0 ]; then
  echo "verifier failure (ungraded): grade.py exited $rc" >&2
  cat /logs/verifier/grade.err >&2
  exit 1
fi

if [ ! -s /logs/verifier/grade.json ]; then
  echo "verifier failure (ungraded): grade.py produced no result" >&2
  cat /logs/verifier/grade.err >&2
  exit 1
fi

/usr/bin/env python3 - <<'EOF' > /logs/verifier/reward.txt
import json
with open("/logs/verifier/grade.json") as f:
    print(json.load(f)["reward"])
EOF

cat /logs/verifier/grade.json

controls/run_validation.py:
"""Run tests/grade.py against the reference and every control; record outputs.

Run with /usr/local/bin/python3 from the authoring workspace. Writes
controls/validation-results.json with reward, subgoal booleans, exit code and
wall time per case.
"""

import json
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
WS = HERE.parent
GRADER = WS / "task" / "tests" / "grade.py"
RAW = WS / "data" / "filtered_gene_bc_matrices" / "hg19"
OUTDIR = HERE / "validation-outputs"
OUTDIR.mkdir(exist_ok=True)

CASES = [
    ("reference", WS / "reference" / "pbmc3k_qc.h5ad", RAW, 0, 1.0),
    ("correct", HERE / "artifacts" / "correct.h5ad", RAW, 0, 1.0),
    ("permuted", HERE / "artifacts" / "permuted.h5ad", RAW, 0, 1.0),
    ("partial-no-log1p", HERE / "artifacts" / "partial-no-log1p.h5ad", RAW, 0, 0.70),
    ("wrong-thresholds", HERE / "artifacts" / "wrong-thresholds.h5ad", RAW, 0, 0.0),
    ("same-shape-wrong-membership", HERE / "artifacts" / "same-shape-wrong-membership.h5ad", RAW, 0, 0.0),
    ("dependency-violation", HERE / "artifacts" / "dependency-violation.h5ad", RAW, 0, 0.20),
    ("missing-counts-layer", HERE / "artifacts" / "missing-counts-layer.h5ad", RAW, 0, 0.0),
    ("nonfinite-counts", HERE / "artifacts" / "nonfinite-counts.h5ad", RAW, 0, 0.0),
    ("malformed", HERE / "artifacts" / "malformed.h5ad", RAW, 0, 0.0),
    ("empty-missing-file", HERE / "artifacts" / "does-not-exist.h5ad", RAW, 0, 0.0),
    ("verifier-raw-input-missing", HERE / "artifacts" / "correct.h5ad", HERE / "no-such-raw", 3, None),
]

results = []
for name, artifact, raw, want_rc, want_reward in CASES:
    t0 = time.monotonic()
    p = subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, str(GRADER), str(artifact), str(raw)],
        capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=300,
    )
    dt = time.monotonic() - t0
    row = {
        "case": name,
        "exit_code": p.returncode,
        "expected_exit_code": want_rc,
        "seconds": round(dt, 3),
        "stdout": p.stdout,
        "stderr": p.stderr[-500:],
    }
    try:
        parsed = json.loads(p.stdout)
        row["reward"] = parsed["reward"]
        row["subgoals"] = {g: v[list(v)[0]] for g, v in parsed["subgoals"].items()}
        row["details"] = {g: v["detail"] for g, v in parsed["subgoals"].items()}
    except Exception:
        row["reward"] = None
        row["subgoals"] = None
    row["expected_reward"] = want_reward
    row["pass"] = (
        p.returncode == want_rc
        and (want_reward is None or row["reward"] == want_reward)
    )
    results.append(row)
    print(f"{name}: exit={p.returncode} reward={row['reward']} "
          f"expected={want_reward} pass={row['pass']} ({dt:.2f}s)")

(OUTDIR / "validation-results.json").write_text(json.dumps(results, indent=2))
print("\nall passed:", all(r["pass"] for r in results))
